import subprocess,json,hashlib,datetime,tarfile,io
from pathlib import Path
name='cuda-fp32-b8'
root='/home/teilo/tmp/wyat-cuda-20261005'
files=[f'benchmarks/analysis/results/{name}{suffix}' for suffix in ('.json','.wall.json','.log','.sources-ae4a797635edfbd1.json')]
r=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8','gpu','tar -cf - -C '+root+' '+ ' '.join(files)],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr.decode())
hashes={}
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(r.stdout),mode='r:') as archive:
 members=archive.getmembers()
 if [m.name for m in members]!=files or any(not m.isfile() for m in members):raise RuntimeError('Unexpected archive')
 for member in members:
  stream=archive.extractfile(member)
  if stream is None:raise RuntimeError('Missing archive member')
  data=stream.read();path=Path(member.name)
  with path.open('xb') as output:output.write(data)
  hashes[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
payload=json.loads(Path(files[0]).read_text());wall=json.loads(Path(files[1]).read_text())
probe=['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8','gpu','nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits; nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits; pgrep -af benchmarks.analysis.cuda.run']
p=subprocess.run(probe,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
receipt={'captured_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Unchanged raw result copy plus terminal GPU/process ownership probe','files':hashes,'wall':wall,'occupancy_release':{'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}}
with Path(f'benchmarks/analysis/results/{name}-copy-release.json').open('x') as output:json.dump(receipt,output,indent=2);output.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'files':hashes,'result':{key:payload.get(key) for key in ('completed','quality_passed','dtype_passed','drift','cuda_control_drift','cuda_memory','error')},'wall':wall,'release':receipt['occupancy_release']},indent=2))
PY
